verdict.rationale: Paxos documents only one of the three named mechanisms: travel-rule handling, through collecting and sending beneficiary information for above-threshold crypto transfers (paxos-docs-7). Identity onboarding decisions and automated fiat-account review are adjacent compliance features, not sanctions screening or wallet risk scoring, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented sanctions screening, documented wallet/address risk checks, depth on travel-rule thresholds and protocols, independent corroboration.
